t.why: French troops and UN peacekeepers have left, and it receives Russian military support. It is a gold producer.
t.rel: It formed the Alliance of Sahel States with Niger and Burkina Faso and left ECOWAS. Relations with Algeria have soured badly over armed groups in the north and the downing of a drone. A landlocked country, it brings in goods through the ports of Senegal and Ivory Coast.
t.korea: Korea's foreign ministry has placed it under a level-4 travel ban.
t.know: The Great Mosque of Djenne is the world's largest mud-brick building, and residents re-plaster it together every year.
t.etext: Gold and cotton are the main exports. The military government has clashed with foreign mining companies by demanding more taxes and larger stakes.
